key_findings: A single intra-articular ALN-HA injection in DMM rats increased paw withdrawal threshold versus NaCl or HA and lowered OARSI cartilage scores more than HA alone.
ALN-HA reduced cartilage MMP-13, MMP-3, IL-6, VEGF and caspase-3 and serum CTX-I; micro-CT bone parameters were unchanged.
